description: Boolean true means that the battery on the aircraft is connected.
Integer Get the battery capacity when the battery is fully charged. Unit: mAh. As the battery is continuously used, the capacity of the battery when fully charged will decrease over time.
Integer To get remaining battery capacity. Unit: mAh.

Integer Get the percentage of remaining battery power. If you need to get the total power percentage of all batteries, you can get all the remaining battery power and battery capacity by setting different componentIndex for calculation.

Long Store at High Battery Level means storing battery when it has 90% or higher battery level. If high battery level storage time in total is less than 120 days in 12 months, battery can be charged for up to 400 cycles. Change Time to Battery Self-Discharge to adjust time of battery storage at high
Double Get the battery temperature. Unit: Celsius. Range interval: [-128, 127].
Integer Get the voltage of a single battery. Unit: mV.
Integer Get the real-time current consumption of the battery. Unit: mA. Negative values indicate that the battery is discharging, and positive values indicate that it is charging.

Integer Gets the total number of discharges that a battery has experienced during its lifetime. The total number of discharges includes discharges that occur through normal use and those that are manually set.
Integer Get the number of cells contained in the battery.
List Get the voltage of each cell contained in the battery.Unit: mV.
Date Get the production date of battery. Note: This interface is deprecated starting from MSDK 5.9.0.
String Get the serial number of battery.
String Get the firmware version of battery.

Integer Set and get the battery self-discharge days. The range interval: [1, 10].
